text_block_list.text:
Christmas. Roommates Narita Top Road and 
Jungle Pocket were having a Christmas 
party just for the two of them in their 
dorm room.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
And so, to celebrate this memorable day, 
let us begin our Christmas party!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"According to the plan, we'll each put on 
a performance, and then exchange gifts 
after—"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Too long, too long! It's a party, isn't 
it? Let's get right into the swing of 
things!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, time for my act. Heheh, I'll 
show you my special magic trick! This box 
will—

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Hoo! Hoo! Hoo!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ah!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I-It flew away!? Crap, please, catch it!! 
It's Fuji-san's pigeon~!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I see... Understood! Let's calm them down 
first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it landed on the doorknob... Is there 
a basket or something... around here?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Aargh, I'll just go in bare-handed!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, crap! This is bad! Did it head over 
toward the lobby!?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeek!? A pigeon!? Why is it in a place 
like this...? Someone catch it, quick~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for causing such a fuss, everyone! 
I'll catch it right away, so please don't 
worry!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I told you to stop already! Jeez, where do 
you think you're going?!

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Hoo! Hoo! Hoo!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh? You're back quite early.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry... Fuji-san! I let the precious 
pigeon you lent me escape. And I ended up 
causing a huge commotion in the dorms, 
too...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll take full responsibility for 
everything, sir! Just tell me what to do!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No. Ultimately, it's my fault for saying 
we should have a party in my room in the 
first place.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, I was the one who 
failed to catch the pigeon and let it out 
into the hallway. Pokke-chan isn't at 
fault.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
That don't make no sense! First off, how'm 
I supposed to lead by example like that, 
huh?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I bear responsibility as the organizer 
too! I can't let Pokke-chan take all the 
blame!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...I see. In that case, I have a favor 
that's just perfect for two close friends 
like you. Would you hear me out?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...And because of that, I was asked to 
take charge of shopping for the dorm's 
Christmas party."
choice_data_list: So that's why you have so much luggage.
So that explains all the bags.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: I told you I'd do it alone, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Didn't they say for the *two* of us to do 
it? Let's give it our all together! Okay?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I'll do it. That was the plan all 
along.
choice_data_list: Have fun at the Christmas party!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, being with Pokke-chan means something 
happens every day, so it's a lot of fun!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm having fun too. Wondering what 
kind of sleep talk you'll come up with 
today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Talking in my sleep...? What on 
earth am I saying!?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind telling you, but are you sure 
it's okay to say it in front of Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh! Ah! No, that's no good, absolutely 
not...! Pokke-chan, make sure to let me 
know when you get back to your room, 
okay!?

It seems Narita Top Road is getting along 
well with everyone at the dorms, too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a shame that I cannot invite 
Trainer along.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Why not? Let's invite 'em. If we talk to 
Fuji-san, she'll probably sort something 
out, right?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Huh...! D-Do you really think so!? Maybe 
I'll try talking to them, then...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Even if things don't go well, I'll still 
bring some snacks to the Trainer's office!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It might be small in scale, but let's 
throw a Christmas party!

Afterward, we enjoyed a little Christmas 
party with Narita Top Road and the others, 
who had brought over refreshments.
